metadata.case_name: LO WAI KEUNG v. KINGS LIGHT INDUSTRIAL LTD. AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Mechanic and hair-stylist; worked in the production department as a mechanic
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: Light work, such as lift operator, watchman, office attendant
plaintiff.education_level: Left primary school during the second term in Primary 5

injuries.description: His right thumb was crushed in the region of its distal phalanx. The broken bone was fixed by wire.
source: His right thumb was crushed in the region of its distal phalanx. The broken bone was fixed by wire.

injuries.description: His right index finger was poorly damaged, and revision amputation was done at the base of proximal phalanx.
source: His right index finger was poorly damaged, and revision amputation was done at the base of proximal phalanx.
Revision amputation, meaning amputation with new coverage of skin, was performed on all the three injured fingers.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: The middle finger suffered from the same fate, but at a slightly higher level than the base of proximal phalanx.
source: The middle finger suffered from the same fate, but at a slightly higher level than the base of proximal phalanx.
Revision amputation, meaning amputation with new coverage of skin, was performed on all the three injured fingers.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of two or more fingers alone

injuries.description: The right ring finger was amputated at the distal interphalangeal joint.
source: The right ring finger was amputated at the distal interphalangeal joint.
Revision amputation, meaning amputation with new coverage of skin, was performed on all the three injured fingers.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

manifestations.description: End portion of the right thumb is painful; stiffness in its middle joint giving added discomfort.
Cannot do a full hand grip.
Has no pinch grip; hence he cannot pick up objects.
Right thumb is deformed outwards; chronic deformity in the thumb nail.
Thin skin covering for the thumb stump is inadequate; stump is not healthy.
Middle and ring finger stumps have thin covering/padding and cause pain; further amputation required to remove pain.
No index finger and almost no middle finger; about two-thirds of right ring finger remains; little finger provides anchorage.
Assessed as suffering from a 70% permanent disability.
Assessed as an 80% permanent loss of earning capacity.
Assessed as having a 20% cosmetic disability.
Severe pain requiring large quantities of pain-killing pills; pain aggravated by weather changes.

treatments_received: Confined in Princess Margaret Hospital for 7/8 days
Re-admitted into hospital two weeks later for three days
Wire fixation of broken bone of right thumb
Revision amputation performed on index, middle and ring fingers
Physiotherapy (attended Yan Oi Tong Clinic and South Kwai Chung Polyclinic)
Occupational therapy (attended South Kwai Chung Polyclinic)
treatments_future: Amputation (excision) of the distal phalanx of the right thumb
Further amputation of middle and ring fingers to remove pain

losses.description: Right hand cannot discharge the three principal functions of grasping, pinching and hooking; no full hand grip; no pinch grip; cannot pick up objects; little finger provides only anchorage.
Cosmetic disability assessed at 20%; thumb deformed outwards and chronic deformity in the thumb nail; plaintiff embarrassed to reveal injured right hand.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Resumption of any of his pastimes (driving go-carts, playing snooker, skiing, tennis, squash, basketball and badminton) would be out of the question.
Cannot resume previous work as a mechanic or hair-stylist; all manual or skilful jobs beyond his reach; limited to light work such as lift operator, watchman, office attendant.
Engagement to Miss Mak has been terminated and diminution in marriage prospects was taken into account.
